findings.reason: Facts [F1] and step 1.1 assert real eigenvalues for self-adjoint blocks, but the cited spectral theorem only supplies an orthonormal eigenbasis for normal operators, and this item does not derive reality. Add the elementary argument that self-adjointness makes the inner product of an eigenvector with its image real, hence its eigenvalue is real.
